title: Failed save retains input and supports retry after API restart
environment_notes: Runner opens the development SPA, fills the form, stops only the isolated API process, attempts save, restarts that API with the same isolated database, and retries. Process control is external setup; all application actions use the visible UI. API restart occurs again before persistence step.

steps.expectation: With the API stopped, saving shows an error and preserves all entered fields.
After the API restarts, submitting the preserved form succeeds exactly once.
After another API restart and page reload, the saved task and its details remain.
